current_answer: Selected evidence supports real economic activity and useful AI in particular tasks. It does not yet establish adequate returns across the AI investment chain or justify current asset prices. A useful technology and overvalued investments can coexist; this baseline does not diagnose a sector-wide bubble.
summary: A sourced baseline separating company results, funding and procurement, productivity designs and unresolved investment returns.
uncertainty: Current participant payments and debt drawings
Comparable cash investment and returns on capital
Latest forecast vintage and delivered physical capacity

catalogue_card.question: Is AI a Bubble?
catalogue_card.text: Profits at suppliers do not prove that their customers will earn the investment back.
